lines: Click a workspace and it opens as a live workbook in its own tab.
Here's a Kanban board — backlog, in progress, and done, with real cards you can move.
It isn't a screenshot or a static page. It's running software, rendered right inside the browser.
Every workbook is its own little app, and they all live side by side in tabs.
